def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

# one task's program: the one shape, cut out by dropping every one-color row and column, mirrored left to right
from lib import compress
def transform(grid):

# another's: every cell as a block whose side is the number of colors other than the background
from lib import upscale
def transform(grid):
    return upscale(grid, len({v for row in grid for v in row}) - 1)

def components(grid, color):
    """The 4-connected components of cells of the given color, as lists of (row, col)."""
    from collections import deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0]); seen = set(); out = []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] == color and (i, j) not in seen:
                q = deque([(i, j)]); seen.add((i, j)); cells = []
                while q:
                    y, x = q.popleft(); cells.append((y, x))
                    for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                        ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                        if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny, nx)); q.append((ny, nx))
                out.append(cells)
    return out

def transform3(grid):
    bg=lib.background(grid)
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marker=next(c for c in {v for row in grid for v in row} if c!=bg)
    comps=lib.components(grid,marker)
    comp_of={}
    for ci,comp in enumerate(comps):
        for cell in comp: comp_of[cell]=ci
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        mc=max((j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker), default=-1)
        if mc<0 or mc==w-1: continue
        ci=comp_of[(i,mc)]; comp=comps[ci]
        if len(comp)<2: continue
        if max(j for _,j in comp)!=mc: continue
        p1=1 if row[mc-1]==marker else 0  # indicator at mc-1
        for c in range(mc+1,w):
            # period-2 continuation: filled iff (c-mc) odd/even per pattern [p1,1]
            ind = 1 if (c-mc)%2==0 else p1
            # pattern at mc is 1; at mc+k: k even -> 1, k odd -> p1
            if ind and out[i][c]==bg: out[i][c]=1
    return out
for i,p in enumerate(pairs):

def transform4(grid):
    bg=lib.background(grid)
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marker=next(c for c in {v for row in grid for v in row} if c!=bg)
    comps=lib.components(grid,marker)
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for comp in comps:
        if len(comp)<2: continue
        mr=max(j for _,j in comp)
        if mr==w-1: continue
        colcells=sorted(i for i,j in comp if j==mr)
        # topmost cell of each vertical segment in max column
        tips=[i for i in colcells if i-1 not in colcells]
        for ti in tips:
            if grid[ti][mr-1]==marker:
                # horizontal run tip: solid fill to edge
                for c in range(mr+1,w):
                    if out[ti][c]==bg: out[ti][c]=1
            elif ti+1<h and grid[ti+1][mr-1]==marker:
                # diagonal wave tip: zigzag bounce between rows ti and ti+1
                r_=ti+1; c_=mr+1
                while c_<w:
                    if out[r_][c_]==bg: out[r_][c_]=1
                    r_= ti if r_==ti+1 else ti+1
                    c_+=1
    return out
for idx,p in enumerate(allp):
    print(idx, transform4(p['input'])==p['output'])

def transform3(grid):
    bg=lib.background(grid)
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marker=next(c for c in {v for row in grid for v in row} if c!=bg)
    comps=lib.components(grid,marker)
    comp_of={}
    for ci,comp in enumerate(comps):
        for cell in comp: comp_of[cell]=ci
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        mc=max((j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker), default=-1)
        if mc<0 or mc==w-1: continue
        ci=comp_of[(i,mc)]; comp=comps[ci]
        if len(comp)<2: continue
        if max(j for _,j in comp)!=mc: continue
        p1=1 if row[mc-1]==marker else 0  # indicator at mc-1
        for c in range(mc+1,w):
            # period-2 continuation: filled iff (c-mc) odd/even per pattern [p1,1]
            ind = 1 if (c-mc)%2==0 else p1
            # pattern at mc is 1; at mc+k: k even -> 1, k odd -> p1
            if ind and out[i][c]==bg: out[i][c]=1
    return out

def mk_transform(below_mode):
    # below_mode: None, 'stop', 'skip'
    def tf(grid):
        bg=lib.background(grid)
        h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
        marker=next(c for c in {v for row in grid for v in row} if c!=bg)
        comps=components8(grid,marker)
        comp_of={}
        for ci,comp in enumerate(comps):
            for cell in comp: comp_of[cell]=ci
        out=[r[:] for r in grid]
        for i,row in enumerate(grid):
            mc=max((j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker), default=-1)
            if mc<0 or mc==w-1: continue
            if (i,mc) not in comp_of: continue
            comp=comps[comp_of[(i,mc)]]
            if len(comp)<2: continue
            mr=max(j for _,j in comp)
            fire = (mc==mr)
            if not fire and mc==mr-1:
                rstar=min(i2 for i2,j2 in comp if j2==mr)
                if i==rstar+1 and grid[rstar][mr-1]==bg:
                    fire=True
            if not fire: continue
            p1=1 if row[mc-1]==marker else 0
            for c in range(mc+1,w):
                ind = 1 if (c-mc)%2==0 else p1
                if not ind or out[i][c]!=bg: continue
                if below_mode and i+1<h and grid[i+1][c]==marker:
                    if below_mode=='stop': break
                    else: continue
                out[i][c]=1
        return out
    return tf
for mode in (None,'stop','skip'):
    tf=mk_transform(mode)
    res=[tf(p['input'])==p['output'] for p in ALL]
    print(mode, all(res), res if not all(res) else '')

def mk_transform3gate(grid):
    bg=lib.background(grid)
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marker=next(c for c in {v for row in grid for v in row} if c!=bg)
    comps=components8(grid,marker); comp_of={}
    for ci,comp in enumerate(comps):
        for cell in comp: comp_of[cell]=ci
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for i in range(h):
        mc=max((j for j,v in enumerate(grid[i]) if v==marker), default=-1)
        if mc<0 or mc==w-1: continue
        if (i,mc) not in comp_of: continue
        comp=comps[comp_of[(i,mc)]]
        if len(comp)<3: continue
        mr=max(j for _,j in comp)
        fire=(mc==mr)
        if not fire and mc==mr-1:
            rstar=min(i2 for i2,j2 in comp if j2==mr)
            if i==rstar+1 and grid[rstar][mr-1]==bg: fire=True
        if not fire: continue
        p1=1 if grid[i][mc-1]==marker else 0
        for c in range(mc+1,w):
            ind=1 if (c-mc)%2==0 else p1
            if ind and out[i][c]==bg: out[i][c]=1
    return out

def mk_gen(gate_len, below=None):
    def tf(grid):
        bg=lib.background(grid); h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
        marker=next(c for c in {v for row in grid for v in row} if c!=bg)
        comps=components8(grid,marker); comp_of={}
        for ci,comp in enumerate(comps):
            for cell in comp: comp_of[cell]=ci
        out=[r[:] for r in grid]
        for i in range(h):
            mc=max((j for j,v in enumerate(grid[i]) if v==marker), default=-1)
            if mc<0 or mc==w-1: continue
            if (i,mc) not in comp_of: continue
            comp=comps[comp_of[(i,mc)]]
            if len(comp)<gate_len: continue
            mr=max(j for _,j in comp)
            fire=(mc==mr)
            if not fire:
                rstar=min(i2 for i2,j2 in comp if j2==mc)
                if i==rstar+1 and mc>0 and grid[rstar][mc-1]==bg: fire=True
            if not fire: continue
            p1=1 if grid[i][mc-1]==marker else 0
            for c in range(mc+1,w):
                ind=1 if (c-mc)%2==0 else p1
                if not ind or out[i][c]!=bg: continue
                if below=='stop' and i+1<h and grid[i+1][c]==marker: break
                if below=='skip' and i+1<h and grid[i+1][c]==marker: continue
                out[i][c]=1
        return out
    return tf
for gl in (2,3):
    for bw in (None,'stop','skip'):
        tf=mk_gen(gl,bw)
        res=[tf(p['input'])==p['output'] for p in ALL]

        fl=tuple(sorted((i,j) for i in range(16) for j in range(19) if o[i][j]!=test[i][j]))
        print(gl,bw,all(res),fl)

def compsof(grid):
    bg=lib.background(grid)
    marker=next(c for c in {v for row in grid for v in row} if c!=bg)
    comps=components8(grid,marker); comp_of={}
    for ci,comp in enumerate(comps):
        for cell in comp: comp_of[cell]=ci
    return bg,marker,comps,comp_of

def features(p):
    g=p['input']; o=p['output']
    bg,marker,comps,comp_of=compsof(g)
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    rows=[]
    for i in range(h):
        mc=max((j for j,v in enumerate(g[i]) if v==marker), default=-1)
        if mc<0: continue
        run=[j for j,v in enumerate(g[i]) if v==marker and j==mc or (j<mc and all(g[i][k]==marker for k in range(j,mc+1)) and (j==0 or g[i][j-1]!=marker))]
        # simpler: run containing mc
        a=mc
        while a>0 and g[i][a-1]==marker: a-=1
        rlen=mc-a+1
        comp=comps[comp_of[(i,mc)]] if (i,mc) in comp_of else []
        mr=max(j for _,j in comp) if comp else -1
        # fill in output
        fills=[j for j in range(mc+1,w) if o[i][j]==1 and g[i][j]==bg]
        if not fills and mc==w-1: 
            rows.append((i,mc,rlen,mr,comp and len(comp),'EDGE','runs',None,None))
            continue
        patt='solid' if fills==list(range(mc+1,mc+1+len(fills))) and len(fills)>0 else ('sparse' if fills else 'none')
        rows.append(dict(i=i,mc=mc,rlen=rlen,mr=mr,csize=len(comp) if comp else 0,
            ltip=1 if g[i][mc-1]==marker else 0, labv=1 if i>0 and g[i-1][mc]==marker else 0,
            patt=patt, fills=fills))
    return rows
for k,p in enumerate(ALL):
    print('pair',k)
    for r in features(p): print('  ',r)

def binarize(grid, bg=None):

    from collections import Counter
    if bg is None:

    """Cells of the pivot color take the value of the grid's other pivot-excluded color; every other color becomes fill."""
    others = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row} - {pivot})
    m = {pivot: others[0]}

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(h):

    """Every row filled with the color of the colored row at the same phase mod the smallest period making colored rows distinct."""
    h = len(grid)
